description: Envelope generator imitating the voltage shapes of the vactrol circuits in hardware low-pass gates, which suits percussive envelopes

params.text: The rise time of the slew, 0 to 300ms
The fall time of the slew, 0 to 1 second
How long the internal envelope stays high, 0 to 1 second
Enabled, any rising edge at GATE fires the envelope; disabled, a rising edge fires it and the gate voltage is then fed to the slew limiter
The rise and fall times and the minimum gate all ten times longer, so fall and minimum gate reach 10 seconds and rise reaches 3 seconds

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over the rise time, scaled by the RISE time knob
A 0-10V CV over that minimum length, scaled by the MIN GATE knob
A 0-10V CV over the fall time, scaled by the FALL time knob
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, added to both shape knobs; the menu can turn it off or invert it for the rise and the fall separately
A trigger fires the envelope; with GT TO TRIG off, the voltage left at this jack when the internal envelope ends is passed on to the slew limiter. The channels patched here set the polyphony

notes: the envelope starts as an internal 10V square, and its shape is whatever the slew limiter makes of that square
menu: Rise shape CV — how the SHAPE input acts on the rise shape: Enable, Enable inverted or Disable
Fall shape CV — how the SHAPE input acts on the fall shape: Enable, Enable inverted or Disable
